title: Long-time existence of some geometric flows with bounded scalar curvature
summary: The analysis of singularities in scalar curvature is a classical problem. In this survey, we investigate the behavior of scalar curvature under several geometric flows, with a focus on three specific cases: the Ricci flow, the Kähler{-}Ricci flow coupled with $(1,1)$-forms, and the Laplacian flow.
